concerns.text: Task T018 contains undefined placeholders: 'set random seed to' (missing value) and 'k' in the p-value formula '(count >= observed + k) / (n + k)'. This prevents the implementation of the statistical validation required by FR-005 (permutation testing on hold-out set) and SC-003.

Task T033 contains a malformed p-value formula: '(count >= observed +) / (n + 1)'. The numerator term is missing, making the statistical calculation impossible. This task is critical for FR-005 (external permutation testing) and SC-003.

Tasks T042, T046, T048, T049, and T050 are marked with [ ] (incomplete) in the 'Revision & Integrity' phase. These tasks address critical gaps identified in the Analyze report (data provenance, resource assertions, reproducibility checks, manifest validation, and simulation disclaimer). Their absence means the plan does not fully cover the requirements for data integrity (FR-007/008), reproducibility (Constitution I), and transparency.

Task T017 includes a malformed citation '(5 (2604.10702, https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10702)-fold CV)'. The number '5' is duplicated with the citation, and the citation format is broken. While the intent (5-fold CV per FR-004) is clear, the text is corrupted.

Task T029 includes a malformed citation '( (Wikidata Q113106917, https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q113106917) )'. The text is empty between the parentheses before the citation, and the citation is redundant. This is a writing error, though the intent (VIF flagging per FR-005) is present.
